def VTask.evenOddRec : {P : ℕ → Sort u_1} -> (h0 : P 0) -> (h_even : (n : ℕ) → P n → P (2 * n)) -> (h_odd : (n : ℕ) → P n → P (2 * n + 1)) -> (n : ℕ) -> P n :=
  fun {P} h0 h_even h_odd n =>
    let f : ℕ → Sort u_1 := P
    let h : ∀ (n : ℕ), P n := by
      intro n
      -- Use the binary recursion on natural numbers to define the property P
      have h₁ : ∀ (n : ℕ), P n := by
        intro n
        -- Use the binary recursion principle to define P for all natural numbers
        induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
        | h n ih =>
          match n with
          | 0 =>
            -- Base case: n = 0
            exact h0
          | 1 =>
            -- Case: n = 1 = 2 * 0 + 1
            have h₂ : P (2 * 0 + 1) := h_odd 0 (h0)
            simpa using h₂
          | k + 2 =>
            -- Case: n = k + 2
            have h₃ : (k + 2) % 2 = 0 ∨ (k + 2) % 2 = 1 := by omega
            cases h₃ with
            | inl h₃ =>
              -- Subcase: (k + 2) is even
              have h₄ : (k + 2) % 2 = 0 := h₃
              have h₅ : ∃ m, k + 2 = 2 * m := by
                use (k + 2) / 2
                have h₆ : 2 * ((k + 2) / 2) = k + 2 := by
                  have h₇ : (k + 2) % 2 = 0 := h₄
                  have h₈ : 2 * ((k + 2) / 2) = k + 2 := by
                    omega
                  exact h₈
                omega
              obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := h₅
              have h₆ : m < k + 2 := by
                omega
              have h₇ : P m := ih m (by omega)
              have h₈ : P (2 * m) := h_even m h₇
              have h₉ : 2 * m = k + 2 := by
                omega
              rw [h₉] at h₈
              exact h₈
            | inr h₃ =>
              -- Subcase: (k + 2) is odd
              have h₄ : (k + 2) % 2 = 1 := h₃
              have h₅ : ∃ m, k + 2 = 2 * m + 1 := by
                use (k + 2) / 2
                have h₆ : 2 * ((k + 2) / 2) + 1 = k + 2 := by
                  have h₇ : (k + 2) % 2 = 1 := h₄
                  have h₈ : 2 * ((k + 2) / 2) + 1 = k + 2 := by
                    omega
                  exact h₈
                omega
              obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := h₅
              have h₆ : m < k + 2 := by
                omega
              have h₇ : P m := ih m (by omega)
              have h₈ : P (2 * m + 1) := h_odd m h₇
              have h₉ : 2 * m + 1 = k + 2 := by
                omega
              rw [h₉] at h₈
              exact h₈
      exact h₁ n
    exact h n
